XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Core — feature flags + audit + shared infrastructure tables

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_feature_flags
TABLE.COMMENT: Phase A0 (2026-05-14) — Feature flag overrides set via the Switchboard UI. A row exists only when an admin has overridden the registered default. Missing rows mean the flag falls through to its registered default in db/feature_flags.php. (key, tenant_id)=0 is the GLOBAL override; (key, tenant_id)=N is the per-tenant override that wins over global.

FIELD.NAME: modified_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who last toggled this row

KEY.NAME: uk_key_tenant
KEY.COMMENT: One override per (flag, tenant). Toggling reuses the same row.

INDEX.NAME: idx_tenant_key
INDEX.COMMENT: Lookup path for is_enabled_for_tenant() — tenant first, then key

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_feature_flag_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Phase A0 (2026-05-14) — Every toggle on the Switchboard creates a row here. Retains the full history for SOC2 / GDPR audit evidence (target retention: 7 years). The Switchboard 'Flag history' page surfaces this as a timeline.

FIELD.NAME: old_value
FIELD.COMMENT: 0|1 before the change; NULL means 'was using registered default (no override row)'

FIELD.NAME: new_value
FIELD.COMMENT: 0|1 after the change; NULL means 'reverted to registered default (override row deleted)'

FIELD.NAME: changed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who toggled — never NULL (the Switchboard requires auth)

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional admin-entered note explaining why this change was made

INDEX.NAME: idx_key_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Timeline lookup for a specific flag's history
